# EvBarChart

> A bar chart - grouped or stacked - drawn in SVG from an array of records.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:bar-chart` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvBarChart } from 'evoq-ui/charts'` |
| Template tag | `<EvBarChart>` or `<ev-bar-chart>` |
| Source | `src/charts/EvBarChart.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-bar-chart">` |
| Used inside | `evoq-ui:chart` (EvChart) |

Charts are a separate entry point. Install the optional peers first: `npm install @unovis/ts @unovis/vue`.

## Example

```vue
<EvBarChart
  :data='[{"bulan":"Jan","realisasi":42},{"bulan":"Feb","realisasi":61},{"bulan":"Mar","realisasi":38}]'
  category="bulan"
  :series='["realisasi"]'
/>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Chart**, frame `4220:71982` (Chart). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Visualize quantitative data — comparisons (bar), trends over time (line), or part-to-whole proportions (pie/doughnut). Wrap in the Chart container for a titled card.

### When not to use

- A few values better shown as text or a table. Pie charts for more than ~5 slices or precise comparisons — use a bar chart (`evoq-ui:bar-chart`) instead.

### Do

- Pick the chart type that fits the data question. Keep color usage consistent across series. Add value labels when exact figures matter.

### Don't

- Don't mix unrelated series in one chart. Don't use 3D or decorative effects. Don't omit axis labels on bar and line charts.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvBarChart`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-bar-chart">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui/charts`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:bar-chart` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
